text_blocks.answer: Sony operates several official websites depending on what you need:

items.answer: Consumer Electronics & Shopping: Visit Sony Electronics to shop for TVs, headphones, cameras, and audio gear. Direct orders often include free shipping and 5% back in My Sony Points.
Gaming: Visit PlayStation for PS5 consoles, games, PlayStation Plus, and accessories.
Product Support & Manuals: Visit Sony Support for troubleshooting, firmware downloads, warranties, and product registration.
Corporate & Investor Info: Visit the Sony Group Portal for company news, sustainability initiatives, careers, and investor relations.
Account Management: Sign in or manage your profile at Sony account.
